# E01 · Final team, nobody is a student

**Deadline:** 14 Oct (team formation closes) ✅ [FAQ](https://aibuildercup.com/Faqs.html)
**Why:** one student on the team disqualifies the whole team ✅ [FAQ](https://aibuildercup.com/Faqs.html). This is the single biggest risk in the whole project and costs 15 minutes.

## Steps
1. Open the Hack2skill dashboard for the AI Builders Cup, Teams section.
2. Team size must be 2 to 4 ✅ [FAQ](https://aibuildercup.com/Faqs.html). Add or remove members until the list is final.
3. Ask every member, in writing (one line each in your team chat is enough): "I am not currently enrolled as a student, I meet the age and region rules in the FAQ."
4. Read the eligibility section of the FAQ yourself once more and compare each member against it. If any line is unclear for a member, assume DQ and swap them out now, not on 18 Oct.
5. Screenshot the final team page.

## Done when
Team page shows final members, every member confirmed in writing. Post "team final, no students" in DM.
